name: Cathy Doll White Milk Shine Body Lotion 450ml | International
description:
Achieve naturally radiant and smooth skin with Cathy Doll White Milk Shine Body Lotion. Its unique white strawberry-like texture helps brighten and even out skin tone while deeply moisturizing and softening dry skin.

Key Features:

Brightening Effect: Lightens skin naturally for a radiant appearance.

Moisturizing & Smooth: Neutralizes dryness, leaving skin soft and touchable.

Gentle Formula: Suitable for all sensitive skin types.

Texture: White strawberry-like lotion that absorbs easily.

Net Weight: 450ml

Made in Thailand

Enjoy a naturally bright, soft, and smooth skin with Cathy Doll White Milk Shine Body Lotion.
